name: Name
accountHintText: Account number for the accountant, e.g. 9420 — general and administrative expenses
isOverheadHint: The monthly amount is split across the month’s projects and added to each project’s cost
expenseCategoriesText: The list employees see when adding an expense. A category in use can be renamed or disabled.
incomeCategoriesText: Income not from clients: partner fees, supplier refunds, bank interest, exchange rate differences.
overheadText: Rent, office and other monthly overhead is split between projects and reduces each project’s net profit.
overheadAuto: Divide by the actual number of active projects in the month
workItemsText: Base price per unit: reel, cover, carousel, story. An employee’s personal rate can be set in their profile (Team → Rates).
